podcast.title: Formation and Evolution
podcast.body: Emily's Army was formed by Joey Armstrong and his friend Cole after watching "School of Rock." The band underwent several name changes before becoming SWMRS. Joey's younger brother, Jacob Armstrong, had a temporary stint playing bass for the group. "That group was known as Emily's Army, and they went through a bunch of name changes...There were some lineup changes, including the temporary appearance of little brother Jacob Armstrong on bass. And then the group changed their name to Swimmers, which is spelled SWMRS."

xref.title: Inspiration and Band Formation
xref.body: Joseph Marciano Armstrong, nicknamed Joey after Joey Ramone, was born on February 28th, 1995. He decided to form his own band, Emily's Army, with a friend named Cole after they watched the movie "School of Rock" starring Jack Black. "And on February 28th, 1995, Joseph Marciano Armstrong came into the world. He's called Joey after Joey Ramon. Joey finally decided to form his own band after he and his buddy Cole saw School of Rock with Jack Black for the first time. That group was known as Emily's Army."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Musical Offspring
xref.body: Jacob Danger Armstrong was born on September 12th, 1998, and is the son of Billy Joe Armstrong. His middle name is "Danger." He played bass temporarily for his older brother Joey's band, Emily's Army, before forming his own band called St. Eddie. "Another song, Jacob Danger Armstrong. Yeah, his middle name is Danger. Came along on September 12th of 1998...including the temporary appearance of little brother Jacob Armstrong on bass. Well, Jacob went off with his own band called St. Eddie."
